sentences.text:
Proceeding Sheet
 Sl. Office
 Date Order

No Note 02. 08.01.2025 TRR, J  The case of the petitioner is that the  respondents have occupied open land to an extent of 25 Square yards in R.S.No.618/1, Nunna Village, Vijayawada Rural Mandal, NTR District,
out of 425 square yards and the respondents have constructed drainage canal through the petitioner's land without acquiring the land under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short "RFCTLARR Act, 2013).

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The Standing Counsel has furnished written instruction of the Panchayat Secretary.

As seen from the written instructions, it transpires that they will conduct a survey of the drainage covered land,
whether the contention of the petitioner is right or wrong and after receipt of the survey report, if there is any land covered under the construction of drainage, the Gram Panchayat is ready to rectify the defect made under the construction of drainage in favour of the petitioner.

In view of the said instructions of the Panchayat Secretary, the Court directs the respondents to conduct the survey in the presence of the petitioner, within a period of three weeks from today and submit report to the Court.
